cohort: 12,395 women who gave birth at Level II and III obstetric facilities in Almaty, Kazakhstan, between January 1, 2019, and December 31, 2019
finding: The main contributors to the overall cesarean section frequency at Level II and III obstetric facilities were Robson classification Group 5 (multiparous women with uterine scars), Group 2, Group 1, and Group 10.
